name: board
description: Mirror an ossify project's lifecycle onto a self-hosted Huly board. Huly is a projection of .ossify/project-state.json, never the source of truth.

interface.shortDescription: See every ossify project's lifecycle on one Huly board.
interface.longDescription: Board projects ossify state onto a self-hosted Huly workspace: releases become milestones, spines become issues, work items become sub-issues and the spine DAG becomes blocked-by relations. The state file stays authoritative; the board is regenerated from it. /board:sync forces a reconcile and /board:doctor reports drift. Codex has no hook system, so run /board:sync when a task that changed ossify state ends.
defaultPrompt: Sync this project's ossify state to the Huly board.
Check whether the board matches the ossify state.
